question: From which assembly constituency did Arvind Kejriwal contest in the General Election to the Assembly Constituencies of the National Capital Territory (NCT) of Delhi in 2025?
solution: The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Arvind Kejriwal**, the current Chief Minister of Delhi and leader of the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP), contested from the **New Delhi Assembly Constituency** in the **2025 General Election** to the Assembly Constituencies of the National Capital Territory (NCT) of Delhi. • The **New Delhi Assembly Constituency** is considered a significant constituency as it comprises the heart of the capital city, including administrative and political hubs. • Kejriwal has a historical connection with the **New Delhi seat**, having contested and won from this constituency in the **2013, 2015, and 2020 Delhi Assembly Elections**. • The New Delhi seat is known for its diverse electorate, comprising government employees, urban professionals, and residents of prominent localities. • In the 2025 election, Kejriwal's candidacy from this seat reaffirms his focus on urban governance, public welfare schemes, and grassroots development in Delhi.
